text:
emma: quick post-incident follow-up — incident resolved but we need a short RBAC hardening checklist. summary: svc-payments temporarily got role admin-bypass via mitigation automation; audit shows grant at 02:17 UTC but no explicit approval record.

chris: oncall — confirmed. mitigation revoked at 02:45 and we rotated the service key for svc-payments. still spotting a few legacy roles with broad perms.

jordan: infra — logs excerpt: ```audit.log 2026-02-15T02:17:03Z grant role=admin-bypass to=svc-payments by=automation-id/mitigate-runner42```

jordan: also looked at KMS usage: no suspicious decrypts, but key k-pay-prod-1 is due for rotation.

li: platform — propose checklist:
1) verify audit trail completeness & add alerting for automation-origin role grants
2) remove admin-bypass from mitigation automations; switch to scoped escalate tokens
3) run a least-privilege sampling for svc-* (canary cohort)
4) rotate KMS keys used by payment services and update key policy to require MFA approver for rotation

emma: can someone pick up items 1 & 2? @jordan for audit checks and @li for automation changes?

jordan: I can own audit trail checks + wire an alert. will add a dashboard link and post PR for pipeline allowlist.

audit-bot: Incident INC-2026-056 marked resolved and evidence uploaded: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-056/evidence.zip

chris: runbook note — change mitigation steps: do NOT grant admin-bypass. instead use ephemeral scoped escalate token (10m) + OOB approval flow. I'll draft wording.

li: scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to roll out runbook + automation changes. creating a short doc in #eng-security-docs and a PR template for mitigation automation.

emma: action items (ETA EOD Thu):
- emma: write blameless incident note + RCA summary
- jordan: implement audithook + pager alert for automation-origin role grants
- li: update runbook + automation PR to remove admin-bypass use
- chris: KMS rotation plan + re-encrypt window estimate

jordan: quick alert snippet I'll add to alerting rules: ```when event.type == "role_grant" and event.role in ["admin-bypass","superadmin"] and event.actor.type == "automation" then notify(security-oncall)```

chris: noted. I will also add a pre-rotation smoke test for dependent services and list expected downtime windows.

li: one more ask — add least-privilege sampling metrics to monthly security dashboard (coverage %, number of broad-role grants). I'll follow up with product to get quota for canary sampling.

emma: perfect. thanks everyone — reconvene after the sync. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
